functions._alpGetPat: function _alpGetPat() { try { return localStorage.getItem("eli_alp_pat") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; } }
functions._alpGetRepo: function _alpGetRepo() { try { return localStorage.getItem("eli_alp_repo") || "apndrewn/eli-data"; } catch (e) { return "apndrewn/eli-data"; } }
functions._alpGetBranch: function _alpGetBranch() { try { return localStorage.getItem("eli_alp_branch") || "main"; } catch (e) { return "main"; } }
functions._alpSetBranch:
function _alpSetBranch(v) { try { localStorage.setItem("eli_alp_branch", String(v || "main")); } catch (e) { } }
